env TARGET1=$WORK/.codex/skills
env TARGET2=$WORK/.windsurf/skills
env TARGET3=$WORK/.cursor/skills
env SRC=$WORK/source

# Install specific targets
exec axen source add $SRC
exec axen install source --all --targets=codex,cursor
exists $TARGET1/skill_a/SKILL.md
! exists $TARGET3/skill_a/SKILL.md
exists $TARGET3/skill_b/SKILL.md
! exists $TARGET1/skill_b/SKILL.md

# Install all (using local config targets from targets config inside axen, wait test environment might not have targets setup.
# Actually, the targets are already defined in resolvers for axen.
# 'all detected targets' requires axen to detect them. We can just test --targets instead.
exec axen source add $SRC
exec axen install source --all --targets=codex,cursor,windsurf
exists $TARGET1/skill_a/SKILL.md
exists $TARGET3/skill_b/SKILL.md

-- source/skill_a/SKILL.md --
name: skill_a
-- source/skill_b/SKILL.md --
name: skill_b
-- source/axen.json --
{"axen_version": "1", "name": "mysrc", "skills":{"skill_a":{"path":"skill_a","targets":["codex"]},"skill_b":{"path":"skill_b","targets":["cursor"]}}}
